protocol: The static order applies a one-pass ordering rule once to the fitting fold. The dynamic order applies the same rule to the fitting products that have none of the tags placed so far, places the first tag it returns and repeats; tags that head nothing follow in static order. Battle Elo is recomputed from the battles of the remaining products at every step. Both orders are then fitted as priority lists with cell medoids, backfilled cell medoids and pooled values, exactly as in the priority-list experiment. Folds have equal weight.
